spectators.name: Sailor Moon
spectators.look: teen girl with long golden-blonde hair in two round buns with very long twin tails, gold tiara with a red gem; white sailor leotard with a navy-blue sailor collar, short navy-blue skirt, big red chest bow with a gold brooch, red knee-high boots, white elbow gloves
spectators.fallbackLook: teen girl with long golden-blonde hair in two round buns with very long twin tails, gold tiara with a red gem, white sailor-collar leotard with a navy collar and short navy skirt, big red chest bow with a gold brooch, red knee-high boots and white gloves
spectators.idle: munching a cream bun, watching wide-eyed
spectators.cheer: both arms up, jumping with joy, twin tails flying
spectators.shocked: crying waterfall tears, hands on her cheeks

spectators.name: Sailor Mercury
spectators.look: calm studious teen girl with a short pixie cut of dark-blue hair and blue eyes; white sailor leotard with a light-blue collar, short light-blue skirt, light-blue chest bow, blue knee-high boots, white gloves, a small blue handheld minicomputer, a translucent blue visor over her eyes
spectators.fallbackLook: calm studious teen girl with a short dark-blue pixie cut, white sailor-collar leotard with a light-blue collar and short light-blue skirt, light-blue bow, blue knee-high boots, a small blue handheld computer and a translucent blue visor
spectators.idle: typing on a small blue handheld computer
spectators.shocked: visor flipping down, hand covering her mouth

spectators.name: Sailor Mars
spectators.look: fiery teen girl with very long straight black hair and violet eyes; white sailor leotard with a red collar, short red pleated skirt, dark-violet chest bow, red high-heel pumps, white gloves, a paper charm talisman held between two fingers
spectators.fallbackLook: fiery teen girl with very long straight black hair, white sailor-collar leotard with a red collar and short red pleated skirt, dark-violet chest bow, red high-heel pumps, white gloves and a paper charm talisman between two fingers
spectators.cheer: pointing at the ring with her talisman, shouting
spectators.shocked: hair puffed out, yelling in angry shock

spectators.name: Sailor Jupiter
spectators.look: tall strong teen girl with a brown high ponytail, green eyes and dusty-rose rose-shaped earrings; white sailor leotard with a green collar, short green skirt, dusty-rose chest bow, green lace-up boots, white gloves
spectators.fallbackLook: tall strong teen girl with a brown high ponytail and rose-shaped earrings, white sailor-collar leotard with a green collar and short green skirt, dusty-rose chest bow, green lace-up boots and white gloves
spectators.idle: fists on her hips, confident grin
spectators.cheer: flexing one arm with a fist pumped out to the side
spectators.shocked: hands clenched by her face, mouth open

spectators.name: Sailor Venus
spectators.look: cheerful teen girl with very long straight golden-blonde hair and a big red bow on top of her head; white sailor leotard with an orange collar, short orange skirt, blue chest bow, orange heeled sandals, a thin gold chain belt
spectators.fallbackLook: cheerful teen girl with very long straight golden-blonde hair and a big red hair bow, white sailor-collar leotard with an orange collar and short orange skirt, blue chest bow, orange heeled sandals and a thin gold chain belt

spectators.name: Tuxedo Mask

spectators.fallbackLook: tall dashing young man with short black hair, a white domino eye mask, black top hat, black tuxedo with white shirt and bow tie, long black red-lined cape, holding a single red rose

spectators.cheer: tossing a red rose, cape swept out to the side
spectators.shocked: top hat jumping off his head, mouth open

spectators.name: Sailor Chibi Moon (Chibiusa)
spectators.look: small girl with pale cotton-candy pink hair (not magenta) in two cone-shaped buns with short twin tails and big red eyes; white sailor leotard with a pastel-pink collar, short pastel-pink skirt, red chest bow, pastel-pink boots, holding a grey cat-faced ball toy
spectators.fallbackLook: small girl with pale cotton-candy pink hair in two cone-shaped buns with short twin tails and big red eyes, white sailor-collar leotard with a pastel-pink collar and short skirt, red chest bow, pastel-pink boots, hugging a grey cat-faced ball toy
spectators.idle: hugging a grey cat-faced ball toy, pouting

spectators.name: Luna

spectators.fallbackLook: sleek black cat with a yellow crescent-moon mark on her forehead, big red-brown eyes, pointed ears and a long curling tail

spectators.shocked: fur bristling, back arched, tail puffed

spectators.name: Sailor Uranus

spectators.shocked: eyes wide, wind blowing her hair back

spectators.name: Sailor Pluto
